title: DatasetFieldResponse
description: One declared field in GET /api/data-sources/:id/schema's response (HEL-1122 design.md Decision 1). Mirrors DatasetFieldDeclaration field-for-field. `required` is always written, even when `false` -- never omitted. `default` is genuinely absent from the wire body (never a JSON `null`) when the field has no declared default.
